les: Helder water is nog nie veilige water nie
kaps_punt: voorsiening van skoon water is belangrik vir mense, plante en diere; water kan skoongemaak word deur prosesse soos sif, filtrasie, uitsakking, oorgieting, kook en die byvoeging van chemikalieë om kieme dood te maak; munisipale water word skoongemaak voor en na ons dit gebruik het

items.bewering: Kieme uit toiletafval kan in 'n rivier beland. Mense kan siektes soos diarree kry as hulle daardie water drink.
items.bron: WHO, Drinking-water fact sheet (who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/drinking-water): faecal contamination is the greatest risk to drinking-water safety and transmits diarrhoea, cholera, dysentery, typhoid. SA Green Drop reporting (gov.za DWS statements) documents sewage reaching rivers.

items.bewering: Gif soos insekgif kan ook in water oplos. Die gif kan plante en diere siek maak of doodmaak as hulle daarin lewe of daaruit drink.
items.bron: USGS, Pesticides and Water Quality (usgs.gov): many pesticides dissolve in water (neonicotinoids very soluble; some bind to sediment instead, so 'kan' is the right quantifier); toxic to fish, amphibians and invertebrates, including lethal fish kills.

items.bewering: Party maniere maak die water helderder deur dinge uit te haal wat jy kan sien. Ander maniere maak kieme in die water dood.
items.bron: CDC, How to Make Water Safe in an Emergency (cdc.gov/water-emergency): first filter or settle cloudy water, then disinfect by boiling or chemicals - two distinct steps.

items.bewering: Kieme is te klein om met die blote oog te sien. Daarom kan helder water nog kieme en opgeloste stowwe dra.
items.bron: Britannica, Germ theory; Mayo Clinic, Germs: disease-causing microorganisms too small to see without a microscope. Clear water carrying pathogens: CDC emergency water guidance; dissolved substances in clear water: solution chemistry (RSC Nuffield practical collection on filtration).

items.bewering: 'n Sif hou groot stukke soos blare en plastiek uit modderige water terug.
items.blok: Vier maniere om water helderder te maak
items.bron: Sieving as size separation (IIT Kanpur SATHEE, Chemistry: Sieving); screening removes sticks, leaves, rubbish as the first purification step (DePaul University lecture, Water Purification).

items.bewering: By uitsakking staan die water stil in 'n emmer sodat modder en sand na die bodem sak.
items.blok: Vier maniere om water helderder te maak
items.bron: Wikipedia, Settling / Sedimentation (water treatment); Merriam-Webster, sedimentation: particles settle to the bottom of an undisturbed liquid under gravity.

items.bewering: By oorgieting gooi jy die helderder water versigtig bo-af uit sodat die modder agterbly.
items.blok: Vier maniere om water helderder te maak
items.bron: Wikipedia, Decantation; sciencenotes.org, What is decantation: the liquid above settled sediment is poured off, leaving the solid behind.

items.bewering: By filtrasie loop die water deur papier, lap of sand. Stukkies wat te groot is vir die gaatjies bly agter.
items.blok: Vier maniere om water helderder te maak
items.bron: CDC emergency water guidance names cloth, paper towel or coffee filter; RSC Nuffield Practical Collection (edu.rsc.org): solids too large for the paper's holes are retained. Sand filters also trap particles by other means, but the stated claim is true.

items.bewering: Gekleurde water kom net so gekleur uit as jy dit deur filtreerpapier gooi. Die kleurstof het opgelos en sy deeltjies is te klein om vasgevang te word. Hulle versprei tussen die water se deeltjies.
items.bron: RSC Nuffield Practical Collection 11-14 (edu.rsc.org) and Dormston School separation-techniques sheet: dissolved solute passes through filter paper with the solvent; filtration separates only insoluble solids.

items.bewering: Baie kieme is ook so klein dat hulle deur 'n filter kan kom wat jy self maak. Hierdie vier maniere maak water helderder maar kan nie seker maak dat die kieme weg is nie.
items.bron: CDC emergency water guidance (filtering/settling is followed by disinfection); multiple DIY-filter guides agree bacteria and viruses are too small to be reliably trapped by sand/cloth filters. 'Baie' and 'kan' are correctly narrow.

items.bewering: As jy water kook tot dit hard borrel, gaan die kieme dood wat siektes soos diarree veroorsaak.
items.bron: WHO Boil Water Technical Brief (iris.who.int): heating to a rolling boil is sufficient to inactivate pathogenic bacteria, viruses and protozoa; effective against all that cause diarrhoeal disease. (CDC adds 1 minute of boiling; the lesson's claim matches WHO.)

items.bewering: Kook haal nie modder of opgeloste stowwe uit nie.
items.bron: WHO Boil Water Technical Brief; New York State DOH, Boil Water Response: boiling does not remove salts, heavy metals or most chemicals, and may concentrate them; not appropriate for gross particulate contamination.

items.bewering: Laat die gekookte water afkoel en hou dit toegemaak in 'n skoon houer. So kom nuwe kieme nie maklik weer in nie.
items.bron: WHO Boil Water Technical Brief (cool naturally, protect from recontamination during storage); CDC: store boiled water in clean, sanitised containers with tight covers.

items.bewering: 'n Chemikalie kan ook kieme in water doodmaak en die waterwerke gebruik gewoonlik chloor.
items.bron: Rand Water Zuikerbosch process (Engineering News / SAnews, 2025): final chlorination before distribution, two chlorine plants on site; DePaul University lecture on municipal treatment: chlorination as the disinfection step. 'Gewoonlik' is correctly qualified.

items.bewering: By die huis kan 'n grootmens watersuiweringstablette in water gooi soos die pakkie sê.
items.bron: Clasen et al., NaDCC tablets for household water treatment, PMC2803503; Aquatabs FAQ: chlorine-releasing tablets for household use, dosed per the instructions.

items.bewering: Die chloor en die tablette haal nie modder uit nie. Hulle werk ook beter in helder water omdat modder kieme kan wegsteek. Daarom word water eers helder gemaak voordat die kieme doodgemaak word.
items.bron: Journal of Water and Health 13(2):544 (point-of-use chlorination of turbid water) and PubMed 30777799: particles shield bacteria and viruses from chlorine; CDC: disinfection does not work as well in cloudy water, so settle or filter first. The 'wegsteek' image maps correctly onto particle shielding.

items.bewering: Die waterwerke neem water uit 'n rivier of dam. Dit maak water skoon in stappe waarvan jy die meeste ken.
items.blok: Die waterwerke: voordat ons die water gebruik
items.bron: Rand Water draws from the Vaal Dam (Engineering News, Zuikerbosch). 'Die meeste' is accurate and careful: the real sequence also contains steps the lesson does not name (coagulation with lime and ferric chloride, pH correction), so 'most', not 'all', is right.

items.bewering: 'n Sif vang eers die groot goed en dan staan die water sodat vuilgoed na die bodem uitsak. Daarna loop dit deur lae sand. Laastens maak 'n chemikalie kieme in die water dood. Dan loop die water deur pype na die krane.
items.blok: Die waterwerke: voordat ons die water gebruik
items.bron: Rand Water Zuikerbosch (Engineering News 2025): coagulation, gravity sedimentation, rapid sand filtration, final chlorination before distribution; DePaul lecture: screening first. Order screening - settling - sand - chlorine is correct; coagulation is omitted but covered by 'die meeste' in the previous sentence.

items.bewering: Gebruikte water loop uit toilette, wasbakke en storte weg. Dit vloei deur rioolpype na 'n rioolwerke waar dit skoongemaak word voordat dit na 'n rivier of die see loop.
items.blok: Die rioolwerke: nadat ons die water gebruik het
items.bron: Helen Suzman Foundation brief on SA wastewater, and gov.za DWS statements: 824 municipal wastewater systems treat sewage and discharge effluent to rivers and the sea. Read as a description of the municipal system (the CAPS frame); homes on septic tanks or pit toilets are not in scope of the sentence.

items.bewering: So help die rioolwerke keer dat kieme en vuilgoed riviere en die see besoedel. Hierdie water is nie drinkwater nie.
items.blok: Die rioolwerke: nadat ons die water gebruik het
items.bron: gov.za DWS media statement on river pollution by municipal treatment systems; Circle of Blue / Green Drop 2022. 'Help keer' is appropriately modest given that many SA works underperform; treated effluent discharged to rivers is not potable.

items.bewering: Jy kan self 'n sandfilter bou met 'n laag growwe klippies en 'n laag fyn sand. Die growwe klippies vang groter stukke en die fyn sand kleiner stukke.
items.bron: TeachEngineering, The Dirty Water Project; DePaul lecture: sand-over-gravel beds act like a strainer, finer material trapping finer particles.

items.bewering: Jy oordeel watter filter beter werk aan hoe helder die water uitkom. Die vergelyking is net regverdig as elke filter dieselfde vuil water en ewe veel daarvan kry.
items.bron: TeachEngineering, The Dirty Water Project; SARSEF student project documentation: controlled variables include the same dirty water and the same volume; clarity as the measured outcome.

items.bewering: Maar helderder beteken nie veilig nie. Jy drink nie water uit jou eie filter nie omdat dit nog kieme en opgeloste stowwe kan dra. Kook of die waterwerke se chemikalie maak wel die kieme dood.
items.bron: CDC emergency water guidance (filter then disinfect by boiling or chlorine); WHO Boil Water Technical Brief. 'Die waterwerke se chemikalie' is chlorine, confirmed above.

items.bewering: sif: Iets met gaatjies wat kleiner stukke deurlaat en groter stukke terughou.
items.bron: IIT Kanpur SATHEE, Chemistry: Sieving - a mesh that lets smaller particles through and retains larger ones.

items.bewering: uitsakking: Wanneer vaste stukkies in 'n vloeistof na die bodem sak en daar bly lê.
items.bron: Merriam-Webster, sedimentation; Wikipedia, Settling.

items.bewering: oorgiet: Om die vloeistof bo-op versigtig af te gooi sodat wat onder lê, in die houer agterbly.
items.bron: Wikipedia, Decantation; sciencenotes.org.

items.bewering: filtreer: Om 'n mengsel deur 'n filter te laat loop. Die vloeistof gaan deur, en vaste stukkies wat te groot is vir die gaatjies bly agter.
items.bron: RSC Nuffield Practical Collection (edu.rsc.org): filtration separates a liquid from an insoluble solid retained by the filter.

items.bewering: kieme: Baie klein lewende dinge wat 'n mens siek kan maak.
items.bron: Britannica, Germ theory; Dictionary.com, germ: a microorganism, especially one that causes disease. Whether viruses count as living is debated in biology, but 'living microorganism' is the standard dictionary sense of the word and not false at this level.

items.bewering: opgeloste stof: Die stof wat in 'n vloeistof opgelos het, soos die sout in soutwater.
items.bron: RSC Nuffield Practical Collection: solute dissolved in a solvent; salt in salt water is the standard example.

items.bewering: chloor: 'n Chemikalie wat die waterwerke gewoonlik by water gooi om kieme dood te maak.
items.bron: Rand Water Zuikerbosch final chlorination (Engineering News 2025). Read alone the entry is narrow (chlorine has other uses) but nothing in it is false.

items.bewering: watersuiweringstablet: 'n Klein tablet met 'n chemikalie wat kieme in water doodmaak.
items.bron: PMC2803503 (NaDCC tablets release chlorine, a microbicide against bacteria, viruses and parasites); Aquatabs FAQ.

items.bewering: waterwerke: 'n Plek waar water uit 'n rivier of dam vir die krane skoongemaak word.
items.bron: Rand Water Zuikerbosch/Vereeniging plants treat Vaal Dam water for distribution to municipalities (Engineering News; SAnews 2025).

items.bewering: rioolwerke: 'n Plek waar gebruikte water skoongemaak word voordat dit na 'n rivier of die see gaan.
items.bron: Helen Suzman Foundation brief on SA wastewater treatment; gov.za DWS statements on effluent discharge.

opsomming: Every checkable claim in all nine study blocks and eleven glossary entries was confirmed against WHO, CDC, Rand Water/DWS and chemistry-education sources; the lesson carries no ELI10 block, its only superlative-type quantifier ('die meeste' steps) is accurate because coagulation is omitted, and nothing is contradicted or unsettled.
